context: Hybrid fullstack promotional travel and events website with owner CMS

phase_1_discovery.audience: City-dwelling Indian adventure seekers, offbeat travellers, 4x4 communities, and culture-curious weekend explorers.
phase_1_discovery.theme: dark-first; deep black structural surfaces with orange action cues and restrained gold wayfinding
phase_1_discovery.chosen_archetype: Luxury with Swiss high-contrast discipline, transformed by Himalayan field-journal texture

design_concepts.name: The Trail Ledger
design_concepts.direction: Cinematic expedition journal fused with Swiss wayfinding and distressed screenprint. Strongest option for the requested brand.

design_concepts.name: Pabbar After Dark
design_concepts.direction: Nocturnal river-camp mood fused with film credits and topographic contour lines; intimate and premium.

design_concepts.name: Pass / Signal
design_concepts.direction: Off-road rally timing boards fused with Himalayan poster art and documentary photography; energetic booking focus.

design_concepts.name: The Village Almanac
design_concepts.direction: Handmade food/culture field notes fused with archival map marginalia and editorial travel publishing.

design_concepts.name: Altitude Radio
design_concepts.direction: Mountain broadcast identity fused with utility labels, cassette-era typography, and restrained motion.

typography.heading: Bebas Neue, fallback Impact, sans-serif; uppercase, tracking-tight, font-black for poster impact
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, fallback Arial, sans-serif; readable, slightly tracked utility copy
typography.metadata: Roboto Mono, fallback monospace; uppercase labels with tracking-[0.2em]
rules: Do not center-align the app container

colors.contrast: Use paper on ink and ink on paper; orange only for CTAs and active states; gold for non-critical highlights. Avoid pure black and gray.

visual_enhancers.texture: CSS grain/noise overlay using a tiny repeating radial pattern at low opacity; never obscure content
visual_enhancers.map: Topographic contour SVG or CSS contour pattern with animated gold/orange location pin; no generic Google-map styling in the hero
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mostly cardless flat surfaces, 1px warm borders, occasional solid raised panels; no full-screen gradients
visual_enhancers.hero: Full-screen video with bg-black/35 to bg-black/50 directional scrim so mountain detail remains visible; logo and copy offset left on desktop
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Warm monochrome or high-contrast crop, captioned like a field note

component_path: Use .js/.jsx files under /app/frontend/src; use existing Shadcn primitives under /app/frontend/src/components/ui for Dialog, Input, Textarea, Select, Sheet, Table, Tabs, and Sonner.

grids.marketing: Tetris grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12; hero col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2; supporting square col-span-4; tall story col-span-4 row-span-2; leave intentional empty cells.
grids.explore: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with varied col spans; never make equal square cards.
grids.admin: High-density grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4; primary booking/content table spans 2-3 columns; use h-full and direct grid children.

layouts.navigation: Visible desktop nav with supplied primary logo, Explore, Events, Journal/Instagram, Contact, and orange Plan a Trip CTA. Solid or glass background, z-50, mobile Sheet menu only below desktop.
layouts.home: Hero video -> contour-map chapter -> editorial introduction -> Explore three-lane grid -> event conversion strip -> Instagram -> contrast-shift footer.
layouts.events: Left editorial intro and right event rail on desktop; event cards expose date, location, capacity, price and Book Now above fold.
layouts.booking: Shadcn Dialog with name, phone, people count and event summary; Razorpay checkout triggered after validation.
layouts.admin: Protected owner shell with compact sidebar, resource tabs, CRUD tables, upload affordance, bookings and messages.

motion.entrance: Staggered reveal for cards and labels; 500-700ms opacity/transform only
motion.hero: Slow video scale/parallax and logo fade; respect prefers-reduced-motion
motion.hover: Buttons translate-y-0.5 with explicit hover text color; cards lift -translate-y-1 and border warms
motion.map: Subtle contour drift and pulsing marker, aria-hidden for decoration
motion.scroll: Use Lenis if dependency is available; otherwise native smooth scrolling. Never use transition: all.

requirements: All interactive and key informational elements include data-testid in kebab-case
Keyboard-visible focus rings with high contrast
Video has poster/fallback and aria-hidden when decorative
Provide text alternatives for map and images
Razorpay failure and success states are announced
Normal text minimum 4.5:1 contrast and large text minimum 3:1

media.video: Use a scenic mountain placeholder video from a stable public source or local public asset; include poster and muted autoplay loop playsInline. Do not use placeholder image URLs.
media.image_behavior: Use object-cover, max-h-[80vh] on mobile, lazy-load below-fold images, caption every editorial image.
media.map_embed: Google Maps Rohru town embed belongs in Contact with a visible fallback link and accessible title.

3d_libraries.decision: 2D clarity plus cinematic motion is sufficient; no 3D dependency required.
3d_libraries.optional: Use lightweight SVG contour animation; do not add R3F unless a real terrain asset becomes available.

brand_primary_logo.description: Supplied Roaming From Rohru primary logo

brand_round_badge.category: map marker, mobile nav, social strip

integrations.payments: Razorpay is explicitly selected; implement server-created orders, signature verification, failure handling, and never trust client price.
integrations.admin_auth: Emergent-managed Google social login; allow only roamingfromrohru@gmail.com and enforce backend authorization on every admin endpoint.
integrations.backend: FastAPI endpoints for CRUD, uploads, bookings, messages and contact settings; validate ownership and paginate tables.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the public experience first, then authenticated CMS.
Use supplied assets everywhere the brand appears; never substitute text logo or placeholder logo.
Use Shadcn only for advanced interactions; use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing composition.
Keep copy concise and field-journal-like; placeholder content must be clearly replaceable by admin.
Add data-testid to every button, link, form control, event price/capacity, error and confirmation.
Create robust loading, empty, error, payment success and payment failure states.
Do not use complete transparent surfaces under content; do not use forbidden purple or generic gradients.
